correctness.rationale: The primal unit ball has exactly the 16 oriented edge molecules because every nonedge pair has a length-two geodesic. Total unimodularity of the reduced incidence constraints makes dual vertices integral; independent reconstruction gives exactly 26 extreme dual functionals and 128 norming pairs. The repository certificate contains 416 exact rational dual certificates, one for every primal/dual operator-norm evaluation; this audit parsed the actual certificate and verified every coefficient identity and that every dual weight sum is at most two, proving \(\|T\|\le2v(T)\). Independently reconstructing the explicit witness gives numerical radius one and operator norm two. Thus the index is exactly one half.

value.rationale: The five-point wheel is a canonical smallest non-complete wheel, and its exact index gives a concrete boundary to the complete three-point rigidity theorem. The exact certificate also provides a reproducible benchmark for higher-dimensional Lipschitz-free numerical-index computations.
residual_risks: The result is a single exact example rather than a family classification.

final_claim: For the five-point wheel graph metric \(W_4=C_4\vee K_1\), the real Lipschitz-free space satisfies \(n(\mathcal F(W_4))=1/2\), providing a non-equilateral finite metric beyond the three-point equilateral rigidity theorem.
limitations: This is one five-point metric; no formula for larger wheels or arbitrary graph metrics is claimed.
